title: Ravnica: Clue Edition: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: As far as the Orzhov Syndicate is concerned, it is the height of irresponsibility not to have a plan for your own ghost.
"Keep up with me, comrades, or I cannot guarantee you a fair share of the fracas."
Wealthier than ever thanks to exorbitant interest on wartime loans, the Orzhov only grew hungrier for more.
Her theories are grounded. Her experiments are not.
The Gruul believe the best way to protect Ravnica's wilderness is to destroy civilization and all who defend it.
The recruits had a lot to learn. Luckily, she had a lot to teach.
"The next punch you throw hits the back of your own head."
A hideous, living residue of countless corpses dissolving anonymously in the scummy depths.
"This little piggy goes to war!"
"Attention, brawlers! You are in violation of Senate statute 2309.76-22. Halt your melee before you incur further charges."
"I bestow upon you a great honor—your flesh alone will nourish a new generation of saprolings."
Dress for the job you want them to think you have.
It is spring incarnate, its gentle warmth chasing away the last of winter's bite.
Planeswalkers conjured replicas of old allies, reminders of the homeworlds that would fall next if Bolas prevailed.
"You have the right to remain silent. Mostly because I tire of your excuses."
"Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."
When its power is threatened, the council speaks with a unified voice.
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable." —Horance, Urzan general
He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.
"A company of infantry is trapped behind the lines. We need to strike hard and fast to free them, or the casualties will be horrific. Send the griffins." —Tajic
The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.
"The blood of the enemy is a sacrament. The strength it gives is proof that our cause is just."
Honor the gods of Theros, and they will return the favor.
"See that no one enters or leaves New Prahv today. And notify me at once of any Planeswalker activity." —Dovin Baan
"The southern fortress taken by invaders? Heh, sure . . . when elephants fly." —Brezard Skeinbow, captain of the guard
"'Invincible' is just a word." —Gideon Jura
"Too many have disappeared in these dark days. I am the light that will lead them home."
The guildmasters loom large in the political sphere, but in the end, the rulers of Ravnica are its people.
Rocs' innate fearlessness makes them ideal mounts for emergency response.
"No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."
"Lady Wren is the one merchant in Keyhole Downs who isn't running a scam." —Mirela, Azorius hussar
"Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"
"Entrance is free. Donations are required." —Notice outside Vizkopa Bank
"Many wings haunt the skies these days. Few of them bear good tidings." —Lavinia
In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.
"Would you give your life to save this world?" Gideon murmured. The pegasus snorted and spread wide its mighty wings.
A pet that can hunt both flesh and spirit is precious in a place where smiling assassins keep company with ghostly shadows.
"I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement. I'm sure this comes as no surprise to you." —Teysa, to Lazav
Soaring over Vitu-Ghazi, New Prahv, and Orzhova, the Conclave's trained falcons provided critical intelligence.
"My specialty is theoretical universal limits and ways to circumvent them."
"I can see which way the wind is blowing."
Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!
An Izzet experiment begins with a "what if," gets approved with a "why not," and concludes with a "eureka!"
Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.
"Most compete for insects at street level. Some dwell near Izzet laboratories and ride the thermal updrafts." —Yolov, Simic bioengineer
"My doors are called trespassing, my signatures, forgeries. They don't respect my talents, and I don't respect their labels."
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome." —Speaker Trifon
"Your deed cannot be undone. You, however, can be." —Agosto, Azorius imperator
"Now, little fighter, show me you deserved this second chance."
Some who die senseless deaths return as formless spirits, seeking answers where there are none.
The streets of Ravnica are full of former guild members now using their institutional skills for personal gain.
"Life has no mistakes, only experiments." —Yolov, Simic bioengineer
"I was never here."
"Advanced Elemental Manifestations is canceled until all students have thawed." —Prismari dormitory notice
No duelist is without equal in Paliano.
The arrival of the Planar Bridge caused eddies in the aether, creating some entirely new species while transforming others.
"Ribbit."
A screech in the night is all it takes for Orzhov debtors to clutch at their coin purses.
"How did we find each other? So there I was, exploring a mound of monster corpses..."
The Simic use the claws as scalpels, while the Rakdos use them for tattooing and torture. The Gruul use them to pick their teeth after lunching on the rest of the carcass.
"That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."
"Feed the rumor mills with delicious treachery. Bad blood between those two is a good deal for us." —Kamiz, Obscura Oculus
Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.
"Anything a falcon can do, a bat can do in pitch darkness." —Urdnan the Wanderer
"This is why we don't go out in banewasp weather." —Rannon, Vithian holdout
Her footsteps are whispers, her passage a last breath.
When he reaches for his key ring, you should be running for the exit.
"Looks like you need protection."
"The louder their performance, the quieter we become in comparison. They are the perfect distractions, for only fools ignore the Rakdos." —Lazav
"My favorite meal is angel's flesh, slain in agony and iced with black vinegar." —Aszala of House Dimir
No heartbeat to hear, no greed to bribe, no fear of death.
Even the darkest corners of Ravnica still lie in the shadow of the Church.
"I've always said full war chests win wars, but I didn't mean by bashing enemy skulls with them." —Teysa
"Many have sought snake-twined Pharika's panacea. Do you wish to share their fate?"
In theory, the Guildpact keeps guild feuds from spiraling out of control. Personal feuds, however, are not covered.
"You say this Tenth District, not Rubblebelt. But where smash happen, that Rubblebelt. Rubblebelt state of mind." —Urgdar, cyclops philosopher
It's hard to shout "Shields up!" with a javelin in your chest.
"This sort of innovation occurs when you set out to improve an electric tea kettle and misplace a decimal."
"Keep coming. I have knives enough for everyone."
Butcher's training, warrior's heart.
Rain runoff in the Smelting District is known to spontaneously burst into flame.
The flaming fist of Boros holds the promise of both protection and destruction in its grasp.
The upside to not thinking about the consequences is that you'll always surprise those who do.
"Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again." —Domri Rade
To the Rakdos, screams of delight and screams of terror are one and the same.
Krenko's hirelings are unflinchingly loyal.
"Places, everyone!" —Judith
The sparkmage shrieked, calling on the rage of the storms of his youth. To his surprise, the sky responded with a fierce energy he'd never thought to see again.
Not all storms come from the sky.
"Nobody ever listens to my complaints! Not even when I use the listening stick."
"Before they can go to their final rest, the wicked must be purified by fire." —Harra the Adjudicator
As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.
Freed from their respective labs, the two weirds formed a partnership, feeding on the arcane energies of war.
Blood is holy to those whose god is War.
"Nothing ruins a party like one of those big killjoys bursting through the door and setting all the guests free." —Ruba, Rakdos cultist
Common Gruul career aspirations: berserker, shaman, catapult.
He wages war wherever the wind carries him.
"By all means, take another step toward the captain."
The problem isn't the indrik's enthusiasm, it's Ravnica's lack of guardrails.
In times of peril, the vision the ancient paruns had for their city comes into focus.
Krushoks clear debris from fertile fields, fallow fields, and battlefields.
"The tiniest mouse speaks louder to me than all the festival crowds on Tin Street."
For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.
"Might doesn't just build empires. It protects them." —Inti, Sun Empire knight
They often perch on street lamps, causing the poles to buckle under their weight.
"There's no time to calm it down! Run!"
"We're all food for something in the end." —Cevraya, Golgari shaman
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs." —Dars Gostok, Firefist captain
"When the sky screams, when the ground groans, the End-Raze will soon begin." —Nikya of the Old Ways
"Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."
The insectile kraul lurk in the tunnels below street level. Many are loyal to the Golgari Swarm, but others follow their own esoteric caste system.
Looking over two city blocks of destruction, he could only cackle with pride.
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!" —Khemses, charioteer
"Within each of us, the potential for great power waits to be released." —Zija, Simic mutationist
"If the Fin Clade cannot produce a reliable venomous krasis, mobile in both air and water, then the Guardian Project will absorb its resources." —Vannifar
"The presence of the strong will make you stronger." —Yeva, Nature's Herald
"Forget yourself. Forget your city. Forget your homes, your families, the debts and obligations that hold you to this world."
"The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."
Two times the size, four times the smell.
If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.
"Nature can't be stopped. It rips and tears at Ravnica's tallest buildings to claim its place in the sun."
The giant's real punishment was the fleeting moment when he was allowed to stand before being dragged down to his knees again.
Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels. Now the Gateless have marked her for death.
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!" —Judith
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade." —Tajic
Many chemisters are oblivious to the innumerable machinations of their guild, instead focusing obsessively on creating the perfect weird.
Havoc is a small price to pay for data.
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive." —Niv-Mizzet
"Nature is a wonderful engineer but works far too slowly for my tastes."
"All the coins in Ravnica can't save his soul now." —Narbulg Nine Fingers
"The reign of the Swarm begins. Let us rise now and dress ourselves in vengeance."
"If there were such a thing as a soul, I think it would be behind the gallbladder but above the kidneys."
"Entertain me."
Losing his possessions distressed him, but the lack of limbs was strangely liberating.
Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.
"Did you expect me to dodge? How quaint." —Olka, mistmeadow witch
"You've strayed, overworlder."
"Selesnya's soil is sacred, and you're about to meet it with your face."
Orzhov vampires look for allies in unlikely places in case their new guildmaster turns on them. The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.
He has a job to finish, and it's you.
The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride." —Agrus Kos
An emblem of a secret guild, the Dimir insignia is seen only by its own members—and the doomed.
Depending on your point of view, the seal represents a proud guardian of the natural cycle or one who has sold her soul to darkness for eternal life.
Gruul territorial markings need not be legible. The blood, snot, and muck used to smear them are unmistakably Gruul.
The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.
The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.
Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.
The symbol of the Conclave is one of unity, with tree supporting sun and sun feeding tree.

For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.
Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.
"It is our duty to protect all those in need. But the other guilds have never shown themselves worthy of that protection." —Tajic
In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.
Every part of the gate was reclaimed from forgotten ruins and imbued with new purpose by the Swarm.
Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.
Every laboratory buzzes with new experiments, each a piece of Ral's ambitious project.
"So much wealth. So much splendor. So much temptation to believe the gilded lie." —Kaya
Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.
Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.
Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.
As eons passed, the rock wore away, revealing the rich colors at the mountain's heart.
Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.
Wildflowers here bloom not with the season but with the ebb and flow of magic.
All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.
Beauty appears in strange places for those with eyes to see it.
